settings.title: Fabric & Materials
settings.content: Crafted from premium heavyweight combed cotton. Breathable, durable, and pre-shrunk for zero post-wash distortion.

settings.title: Fit & Sizing
settings.content: Designed with a contemporary relaxed drape and dropped shoulders. Take your regular size for the intended silhouette, or size down for a closer fit.

settings.title: Nationwide Delivery & Exchanges
settings.content: Delivered across Pakistan in 2–4 working days via express courier. Cash on Delivery supported. Easy 7-day exchange window if the fit isn't right.

settings.title: Garment Care
settings.content: Machine wash cold at 30°C. Wash inside-out with like colors. Do not bleach or tumble dry. Warm iron on reverse if necessary.
